title: I Think the Small Size Is Good
synopsis:
Ann and her mom are at the shopping mall trying on hanfu dresses. In the end, they find the right sizes.
In this lesson, you will learn how to buy clothes at the shopping mall and learn expressions for trying on clothes and clothing sizes.

fullText.simplified:
我觉得小码不错

营业员：您好！
Anne：你好！这两件汉服很漂亮，可以试一下吗？
营业员：可以的，请问两件都是您穿吗？
Anne：我穿这一件，我妈妈穿那一件，可以吗？
营业员：好的。您和妈妈穿什么码呢？
Anne：我和妈妈都穿中码。
营业员：这两件都是中码。试衣间在您左边，您可以和妈妈一起去试试。
Anne：好的，谢谢你。
（Anne先试穿好衣服了。）
Anne：我觉得这件有一点儿大，可以试一下小码吗？
营业员：可以的，我找找小码。找到了，这一件是小码，您试试。
（Anne试穿好小码，妈妈也试穿好衣服了。）
Anne：妈妈，我觉得小码不错，你觉得呢？
妈妈：对，小码很好。我女儿真漂亮！
Anne：妈妈，你穿这件汉服也很漂亮。
（营业员走过来。）
营业员：真漂亮！您和妈妈穿汉服都很漂亮！
Anne：谢谢，我们很喜欢，就买这两件吧！
fullText.traditional:
我覺得小碼不錯

營業員：您好！
Anne：你好！這兩件漢服很漂亮，可以試一下嗎？
營業員：可以的，請問兩件都是您穿嗎？
Anne：我穿這一件，我媽媽穿那一件，可以嗎？
營業員：好的。您和媽媽穿什麼碼呢？
Anne：我和媽媽都穿中碼。
營業員：這兩件都是中碼。試衣間在您左邊，您可以和媽媽一起去試試。
Anne：好的，謝謝你。
（Anne先試穿好衣服了。）
Anne：我覺得這件有一點兒大，可以試一下小碼嗎？
營業員：可以的，我找找小碼。找到了，這一件是小碼，您試試。
（Anne試穿好小碼，媽媽也試穿好衣服了。）
Anne：媽媽，我覺得小碼不錯，你覺得呢？
媽媽：對，小碼很好。我女兒真漂亮！
Anne：媽媽，你穿這件漢服也很漂亮。
（營業員走過來。）
營業員：真漂亮！您和媽媽穿漢服都很漂亮！
Anne：謝謝，我們很喜歡，就買這兩件吧！

sentence_translations: I Think the Small Size Is Good
Anne: Hello! These two hanfu dresses are very beautiful. Can we try them on?
Salesperson: Sure, you can. Are both of them are for you to wear?
Anne: I will wear this one, and my mom will wear that one. Is that okay?
Salesperson: Okay. What sizes do you and your mom wear?
Anne: Both my mom and I wear medium size.
Salesperson: Both of these are medium size. The fitting room is on your left. You can go with your mom to try them on.
(Anne finishes trying on the clothes first.)
Anne: I think this one is a bit big. Can I try the small size?
Salesperson: Sure, let me have a look for the small size. Found it, this one is the small size. Please try it on.
(Anne finishes trying on the small size, and her mom also finishes trying on her clothes.)
Anne: Mom, I think the small size is good. What do you think?
Mom: Yes, the small size is great. My daughter is really beautiful!
Anne: Mom, you also look very beautiful in this hanfu dress.
Salesperson: Truly beautiful! You and your mom both look very beautiful in hanfu dresses.
Anne: Thank you. We really like them. We’ll buy these two!
